title: Trust & Navigation Completion — Summary

AQ-02B1.title: Navigation Registry + Hub Integrity
highlights: 10 domain hub pages built and live (were all 404)
/ingredients/ master directory added, linked from every domain hub and 25 core/dish/seasonal static pages
962/962 leaf pages full-census verified: resolvable Foods-nav target + Ingredients-directory link

AQ-02B2.title: Search + Sitemap Completion
highlights: 1,038/1,038 leaf+group+category entities across 10 published domains now searchable (was wine-side only)
sitemap.xml rebuilt deterministically from the published-domain registry every run (was history-dependent merge)
Known risk documented: legacy generate:sitemap script would corrupt the new sitemapindex if run

AQ-02B3.title: Relationship Provenance + Narrative Completion
highlights: 4,140/4,140 rendered relationships independently verified to trace to a real runtime/editorial/wine edge
1,692/1,692 wine-side relationship targets verified to be real entities
Corrected an AQ-01/AQ-01R methodology error: the bearnaise/coconut relationship IS provenanced, prior audits checked the wrong data layer
TC-09 fixed: group/category introduction field now renders (86/86 verified)

AQ-02B4.title: Internal Linking + Publication Integrity
highlights: Whole-site reachability crawl found 51 genuinely orphaned pages (protein deprecated entities) - fixed via registry-driven redirects to their canonical replacements
213 knowledge-integrity findings surfaced (204 cheese scientific_name mislabels, 9 squash-family taxonomy drift) - detection only, not fixed, per Rule 4
43 false-positive findings (beef cuts) caught and corrected before reporting

future_domain_guarantee: All 8 infrastructure modules above are driven by food-domain-config.js's published flag and listPublishedDomainIds() — a future domain that sets published: true inherits a working hub page, sitemap coverage, search indexing, relationship provenance checking, and redirect generation automatically, with zero domain-specific code required in any of them.

regression.verification_method: git status diffed against every protected path after every milestone, before every commit, across all 4 milestones — zero violations at any point.
